preworkout.name: Banana + Mini Whey Shot
preworkout.desc: 🧪 Take Kaged Pre-Workout Elite (Stim Free) now — creatine & beta-alanine included. Fast carbs + light protein on the side.
steps: Mix Kaged Pre-Workout in water and drink 20 min before training
Mix whey with cold water and shake
Eat banana alongside

preworkout.name: Rice Cakes + PB + Honey
preworkout.desc: 🧪 Take Kaged Pre-Workout Elite (Stim Free) now — creatine & beta-alanine included. Light, no-cook fast carbs on the side.
steps: Mix Kaged Pre-Workout in water and drink 20 min before training
Spread PB on rice cakes
Drizzle honey and eat

preworkout.name: Date + Almond Butter + Whey Shot
preworkout.desc: 🧪 Take Kaged Pre-Workout Elite (Stim Free) now. Dates give instant glucose spike — ideal 20 min before lifting.
steps: Mix Kaged Pre-Workout in water and drink 20 min before training
Pit dates and spread with almond butter
Shake whey with water, drink alongside dates

postworkout.name: Huel Black Recovery Shake
postworkout.desc: Immediate post-workout protein hit. Fast and complete.
steps: Shake vigorously with cold water
Drink within 30 min of finishing workout

postworkout.name: Cosmic Shake + Banana
postworkout.desc: High protein + carbs to kickstart muscle repair.
steps: Blend all with ice
Drink immediately after workout

postworkout.name: Huel Black + Greek Yogurt Stack
postworkout.desc: 🔥 Double protein punch. Huel handles speed, yogurt adds casein for sustained repair.
steps: Shake Huel with cold water in shaker bottle
Serve Greek yogurt in a bowl, drizzle honey
Drink shake first, eat yogurt within 15 min — casein extends recovery window

breakfast.name: High-Pro Oats Bowl
breakfast.desc: 🥣 Slow-release carbs + solid protein. Keeps you full till lunch.
steps: Cook oats in milk on stove or microwave
Stir in whey once slightly cooled
Top with berries

breakfast.name: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
breakfast.desc: 🫙 Light, digestive-friendly. Great when stomach is still waking up.
steps: Layer yogurt in a bowl
Top with berries and granola
Drizzle honey

breakfast.name: Besan Chilla + Greek Yogurt
breakfast.desc: 🥞 Indian savoury pancakes. Quick, filling and 100% desi.
steps: Mix besan with water, veggies and spices into thick batter
Cook 3–4 thin chillas on non-stick pan with minimal oil
Serve with Greek yogurt as dip/side

breakfast.name: Besan Breakfast Burrito
breakfast.desc: 🌯 Mexican-Indian fusion breakfast. Besan acts as the tortilla AND the protein. Two birds, one pan.
steps: Mix besan with water, cumin, smoked paprika and chilli into a thin pourable batter
Cook one large thin chilla on non-stick pan — make it big enough to fold like a wrap
Warm black beans separately with a pinch of cumin
Place beans, salsa, cilantro and jalapeño on the chilla
Fold over burrito-style, serve with Greek yogurt as sour cream and extra lime

breakfast.name: Huel Black Morning Shake
breakfast.desc: ⚡ Zero-cook breakfast. On those mornings when you need to move fast. Huel Black has everything you need.
steps: Add Huel Black to shaker with cold water or almond milk
Shake hard for 30 seconds until fully mixed
Add ice if blending — transforms it into a proper thick shake

breakfast.name: Overnight Oats + Whey
breakfast.desc: 🌙 Prep the night before, grab in the morning. Zero effort breakfast with zero excuses.
steps: Night before: mix oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia seeds and honey in a jar
Stir in whey protein and mix well
Seal and refrigerate overnight
In the morning, top with berries and eat cold — no reheating needed

breakfast.name: Protein Smoothie Bowl
breakfast.desc: 🍓 Thick enough to eat with a spoon. Feels indulgent, hits the macros.
steps: Blend Cosmic protein, frozen banana, frozen berries and almond milk — use minimal milk to keep it thick
Pour into a bowl — it should be thick enough a spoon stands upright
Top with granola and fresh fruit
Eat immediately before it melts

breakfast.name: Masala Oats (Savoury)
breakfast.desc: 🌶️ Oats don't have to be sweet. Masala oats taste like upma — comfort food that hits your macros.
steps: Rehydrate soy granules in hot water 5 min, drain and set aside
Heat pan, add mustard seeds — wait for them to pop
Add cumin, onion and tomato — sauté 3 min
Add oats, soy, peas and water — stir everything together
Cook on medium heat stirring frequently until oats absorb water (4–5 min)
Finish with turmeric, chilli, lemon juice and salt

breakfast.name: Soy Poha
breakfast.desc: 🍚 Flattened rice with soy — the upgraded version of every Indian's favourite quick breakfast.
steps: Rinse poha in water for 30 sec, drain and let sit — it will soften
Rehydrate soy granules in hot water 5 min, drain
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves — let them splutter
Add onion and sauté 2 min, add soy and peas
Add poha, turmeric and salt — toss everything gently for 3 min
Finish with lemon juice and fresh coriander

breakfast.name: Mango Lassi Protein Bowl
breakfast.desc: 🥭 Tastes like a dessert, hits like a protein meal. Cardamom makes it feel luxurious.
steps: Whip Greek yogurt with whey protein using a fork until smooth
Add cardamom and honey, mix well
Pour into a bowl, top with mango chunks and granola
Serve cold — pairs great with a black coffee

mains.name: Chipotle Soy Taco Rice Bowl
mains.desc: 🌮 Mexican-Indian fusion. Soy chunks get a chipotle taco glow-up. Rajma meets the border.
steps: Rehydrate soy chunks in boiling water 10 min, then squeeze out all water
Sauté onion + garlic, add soy chunks and cook 5 min until slightly crispy
Season hard with chipotle, smoked paprika, cumin — cook like taco mince
Layer over brown rice with black beans
Finish with salsa, jalapeño, a big lime squeeze and cilantro

mains.name: Paneer Tikka Quesadilla
mains.desc: 🌮 When India met Mexico and had a gains-friendly baby. Charred paneer in a crispy tortilla.

ingredients.item: Tikka spice mix (cumin, paprika, garam masala, turmeric)

steps: Cube paneer, marinate in tikka spices + 2 tbsp Greek yogurt for 15 min
Pan-grill paneer cubes on high heat until charred spots appear
Lay tortilla flat, add paneer + black beans, fold in half
Toast quesadilla on dry pan until golden and crispy on both sides
Serve with remaining Greek yogurt as crema, salsa and lime squeeze

mains.name: Rajma Enchilada Bowl
mains.desc: 🌶️ Plot twist: Rajma IS kidney beans. This is basically Mexican dal. Mind blown.
steps: Cook rajma with tomato passata and the enchilada spice blend
Simmer 15 min until thick and saucy — same as rajma masala, different spices
Serve over brown rice
Top with crumbled paneer, Greek yogurt dollop, jalapeño and lime

mains.name: Soy Mince Arrabiata Pasta
mains.desc: 🍝 Italian fire meets plant protein. Soy mince in a spicy garlic-tomato arrabiata. Proper pasta night.

ingredients.item: Soy Granules or fine Soy Chunks (dry)
Chilli flakes + dried Italian herbs (basil, oregano)

steps: Cook pasta al dente — save 50ml pasta water
Rehydrate soy granules in hot water 5 min, drain and squeeze very dry
Heat olive oil, fry garlic until golden, add soy and cook 5 min until slightly crispy
Add passata, chilli flakes, Italian herbs — simmer 10 min
Toss with pasta using a splash of pasta water to loosen
Top with nutritional yeast and a crack of black pepper

mains.name: Chickpea Paneer Pesto Bowl
mains.desc: 🍃 Italian-Indian fusion. Basil pesto + paneer + chickpeas is a combo that absolutely slaps.
steps: Cook pasta al dente
Pan-sear paneer cubes until golden on each side
Toss warm pasta with pesto immediately off heat
Add chickpeas, cherry tomatoes and spinach — residual heat wilts it perfectly
Add seared paneer on top, squeeze lemon, hit with chilli flakes

mains.name: Chickpea & Lentil Curry
mains.desc: 🍛 The OG. Coconut dal that never misses. Your comfort meal baseline.
steps: Cook dal until completely soft
Add chickpeas, cumin, turmeric, coriander and chilli
Stir in coconut milk
Fold in spinach, simmer 10 min, serve with rice

mains.name: Paneer & Black Bean Tikka
mains.desc: 🔥 Indian classic meets Mexican black beans. High-protein power combo.
steps: Sauté paneer cubes until golden
Add beans, sauce, yogurt and tikka spices
Simmer 20 min
Serve with rice

mains.name: Huel Hot & Savory
mains.desc: 🤖 Zero prep, zero dishes, zero excuses. Add boiling water and you're done. Lifesaver on chaotic days.
steps: Add Huel Hot & Savory to bowl
Pour boiling water, stir well
Cover and wait 5 min for best texture
Add a squeeze of lemon or hot sauce if you want to jazz it up

mains.name: Saag Paneer + Soy + Brown Rice
mains.desc: 🌿 Classic saag paneer levelled up with soy chunks for extra protein. Spinach never looked so serious.
steps: Rehydrate soy chunks in hot water 10 min, squeeze dry, set aside
Blanch spinach 2 min, blend into smooth paste
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger until golden — add spices
Add spinach paste, cook 5 min
Add soy chunks and paneer cubes, stir in Greek yogurt
Simmer 8 min, serve with brown rice

mains.name: Paneer Soft Tacos with Pico de Gallo
mains.desc: 🌮 The paneer taco you've been waiting for. Spiced paneer, fresh pico, creamy yogurt crema. Street food vibes.
steps: Slice paneer into strips, season with cumin, paprika, chilli — pan-fry 3 min each side
Make pico: dice tomato, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, mix with lime juice and salt
Warm tortillas directly on gas flame or dry pan
Assemble: black beans on tortilla first, paneer strips on top
Finish with pico de gallo, a dollop of Greek yogurt crema, extra lime

mains.name: Dal Makhani Style Bowl
mains.desc: 🫕 Slow-cooked black lentils with a smoky depth. Greek yogurt replaces cream — you won't notice.

ingredients.qty: 1 tsp (the one tsp of flavour that matters)

steps: Sauté garlic-ginger paste in 1 tsp butter until golden
Add tomato passata, garam masala, smoked paprika — cook 8 min until deep red
Add cooked urad dal and rajma, simmer 20 min on low
Stir in Greek yogurt off the heat — prevents curdling
Serve over brown rice

mains.name: Soy Chunk Burrito Bowl
mains.desc: 🌯 The fully-loaded bowl. Everything a burrito has — minus the tortilla, plus the gains.
steps: Rehydrate and squeeze dry soy chunks, cook with cumin, chipotle and garlic powder
Build the bowl in layers: rice base, then beans, corn, soy mince
Add salsa and Greek yogurt side by side on top
Finish with jalapeño slices, lime squeeze and cilantro
Mix everything together before eating — the flavour combination is the point

mains.name: Chickpea Alla Puttanesca
mains.desc: 🍝 The Roman sauce with capers and olives, but chickpeas as the hero. Bold, briny, zero fuss.
steps: Cook pasta al dente
Heat olive oil, fry garlic until fragrant
Add passata, capers, olives, chilli flakes and oregano — simmer 12 min
Add chickpeas, cook 5 more min
Toss with pasta, adjust seasoning
No cheese needed — the capers and olives are the salty punch

mains.name: Soy Bolognese + Whole Wheat Pasta
mains.desc: 🍝 Rich, slow-simmered Italian bolognese — just built with soy instead of beef. Genuinely great.
steps: Rehydrate soy granules, drain and squeeze very dry
Finely dice carrot, celery, onion — the soffritto is what makes this taste real
Cook soffritto in olive oil on low heat 8 min until soft
Add garlic and soy, cook 5 min until lightly browned
Add passata, herbs and bay leaf — simmer 25 min on low
Cook pasta al dente, toss with bolognese, top with nutritional yeast

mains.name: Palak Soy Dal
mains.desc: 🌿 The leanest meal in the database. Spinach + soy + lentils is basically a superfood triple threat.
steps: Cook lentils until soft with turmeric and salt
Rehydrate soy chunks, squeeze dry, set aside
Sauté onion and tomato with cumin, coriander and chilli
Add cooked dal, soy chunks and spinach to the pan
Simmer 10 min until spinach wilts and everything comes together
Finish with lemon juice — serve as a thick dal or over brown rice

mains.name: Soy Keema Roti Wrap
mains.desc: 🫓 Indian street food energy. Soy keema wrapped in whole wheat roti — looks and tastes like the real deal.

ingredients.item: Keema masala (cumin, coriander, chilli, garam masala)

steps: Rehydrate soy granules in hot water, drain and squeeze thoroughly
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger until golden — add keema masala spices
Add soy granules and peas, cook 10 min — should look and smell like real keema
Mix Greek yogurt with chopped mint and lemon for raita
Warm rotis on dry pan
Fill roti with keema, drizzle raita, roll up and eat

mains.name: Chickpea Tikka Masala
mains.desc: 🍛 The beloved tikka masala sauce, but chickpeas as the star. Goes hard over rice or with a roti.

ingredients.item: Tikka spice mix (cumin, coriander, paprika, garam masala, turmeric)

steps: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger until deeply golden — don't rush this step
Add tikka spices and cook 2 min until fragrant
Add tomato passata, simmer 10 min until thick and dark red
Add chickpeas, stir in Greek yogurt off the heat
Simmer 10 more min
Serve over brown rice

mains.name: Sopa de Soy (Mexican Soy Soup Bowl)
mains.desc: 🥣 Mexican-Indian fusion soup. Chipotle-tomato broth with soy chunks. Warm, filling and wildly underrated.
steps: Rehydrate soy chunks, squeeze dry
Sauté onion and garlic, add chipotle, cumin and oregano — cook 2 min
Add passata and stock — bring to simmer
Add soy chunks, cook 15 min in the broth until absorbed
Add cooked rice to thicken the soup
Finish with lime juice and cilantro — add jalapeño if you want heat

mains.name: Rajma + Paneer Bowl
mains.desc: 🫕 Classic Indian comfort meal. The rajma masala that heals everything.
steps: Cook rajma masala with onion, tomato and spices
Cube paneer and stir in last 5 min
Serve over brown rice

mains.name: Soy Chunk Masala + Brown Rice
mains.desc: 💪 The highest plant-based protein meal in the plan. Soy chunk masala is undefeated.
steps: Soak soy chunks 10 min in hot water, squeeze dry
Sauté onion-tomato masala with spices
Add chunks, cook 10 min
Serve with brown rice

snacks.name: Roasted Chana + Mini Shake
snacks.desc: 🥜 Indian snack staple meets gym nutrition. Crunchy, portable.
steps: Shake whey with almond milk
Eat roasted chana on the side

snacks.name: Cosmic Shake
snacks.desc: ⚡ The quick hit. Protein sorted in 30 seconds.
steps: Shake or blend all ingredients

snacks.name: Makhana + Mini Shake
snacks.desc: 🪷 Fox nuts are low-cal and addictively crunchy. Season them right and they become a snack addiction.
steps: Dry roast makhana with ghee + seasoning till crispy
Shake whey separately
Enjoy together

snacks.name: Paneer Bites + Almonds
snacks.desc: ⚡ Zero cooking. Great on-the-go protein snack.
steps: Cube paneer, season with chaat masala and lemon
Eat with almonds

snacks.name: Chipotle Chickpea Crunch + Shake
snacks.desc: 🌶️ Mexican bar snack meets gym nutrition. Crunchy, spicy, addictive. Way better than plain chana.
steps: Spread dried chickpeas on a tray, spray with olive oil, roast at 200°C for 25 min until very crunchy
Immediately toss hot chickpeas with chipotle, paprika, cumin, lime zest and salt
Shake whey with water or almond milk
Eat chickpea crunch alongside shake — the crunch-shake combo is lowkey elite

snacks.name: Paneer Queso Bites + Salsa
snacks.desc: 🧀 Mexican-Indian zero-cook snack. Paneer plays queso fresco and it just works.
steps: Cube paneer into bite-size pieces
Toss with smoked paprika, cumin, chilli and lime juice
Serve with salsa as dip and almonds on the side
Optional: quick pan-sear paneer 1 min each side for a warm version

snacks.name: Huel Black Mini Shake
snacks.desc: 🤖 1-scoop Huel as a light snack. Complete nutrition in 30 seconds. Keep a shaker ready.
steps: Shake vigorously with cold water for 20 seconds
Drink within a few minutes for best texture

snacks.name: Spiced Edamame + Mini Shake
snacks.desc: 🫛 Indian spice rub on Japanese edamame. Weird on paper, elite in practice.

ingredients.item: Chaat masala or cumin + chilli + salt

steps: Microwave edamame 3 min or boil 5 min
Drain, season with chaat masala or cumin+chilli+salt+lemon
Shake whey with almond milk
Eat edamame pods (squeeze beans out as you go) alongside the shake

snacks.name: Soy Bhel
snacks.desc: 🌟 Indian street food snack, gym-edition. Puffed rice + soy — it sounds weird, it tastes incredible.
steps: Rehydrate soy granules in hot water 5 min, squeeze very dry, cool completely
Mix soy granules with puffed rice and roasted chana
Add diced vegetables and chutneys
Sprinkle chaat masala, squeeze lemon, toss with coriander
Eat immediately — puffed rice goes soggy fast

snacks.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
snacks.desc: 🫐 Simple, sweet, feels like a treat. Whey stirred into yogurt makes it extra thick and protein-forward.
steps: Stir whey into Greek yogurt until fully combined and thick
Top with berries, crushed almonds and honey
Eat cold — this also works as a dessert after dinner
